info.title: Smart Credit Cabinet API
info.description: Кредитный конвейер для МСБ: кабинет клиента и рабочее место банка.

post.description: Sign in. Test accounts: `client1`…`client8`, `analyst`; password equals login.

get.description:
Find the company in the registry before registering (registry data is public).

409 if the company already has an account, so the client is sent to sign in at once.

post.description: Register a client by INN and sign them in. One account per company in the prototype.

schema.title: Response List Products Api Products Get

post.description: Pick a product by the answer to "what do you need the money for?".

get.description: Prefill company data by INN (signed-in users). Demo companies: 7700000001 … 7700000008.

What the bank would approve automatically right now, per product (clients only).

The same sources and credit rules as the pipeline; nothing is stored. An application
with these terms gets the same decision while the company's data does not change.

post.description: Create a draft for the signed-in client's company.

get.description: Client: own company's applications. Employee: the queue (everything except drafts).

schema.title: Response List Applications Api Applications Get

put.description: Edit a draft, or answer a clarification request (the application goes back to review).

get.description: Full card. Checks and scoring are shown to employees only.

post.description: Send the draft to the bank. Repeating the call with the same key is safe.
Employee decision on an application in manual review.
Client accepts the offer (goes to signing) or declines it (withdrawn).
Client withdraws the application wherever it is their turn.

Client answers the bank's offer with their own terms (a negotiation round); the
application goes back to an employee.

get.description: The loan agreement text with its SHA-256 and a check that the text still matches it.

post.description:
Simulated signing and disbursement. With `agreement_sha256`, nothing is signed if the
agreement has changed since the client read it (409).

Compare payment days against the client's cash flow, as planned and with receipts a week
late; nothing is saved. Without a calendar: the saved one or a template from revenue.

put.description: Save the client's typical month and the payment day; the schedule gets dates.

get.description: Client notifications: events of the client's applications, newest first.

post.description: Mark all notifications of the client as read.

get.description: Statuses, labels and transitions straight from the domain model, for the frontend.
Pipeline health for employees: queue, stuck applications, external services, errors.
